places.quote: they had heard a great deal said of Chesney Wold, and really didn’t know what to do with themselves
places.note: Fictional country house of the Dedlocks; location not identified in the passage.

places.quote: The terrace below is much admired. It is called, from an old story in the family, the Ghost’s Walk.
places.note: Name of a terrace at Chesney Wold; fictional, not locatable beyond the house.

places.quote: came from London only last night by the mail
places.note: Refers to the city as a whole, as the lawyers' point of origin.
